smokeSubset.description: Runs already-promoted managed local ESM, controlled HTTP/HTTPS facade shape, checked-in pure JavaScript dependency, and scoped advanced filesystem snippets without enabling high-risk desktop authority or live network I/O.

examples.title: managed local ESM loader migration

safeProfile.behavior: Safe profile allows managed local ESM only and keeps raw loader hooks plus network/file/data URL imports denied

examples.packagedBehavior: managed local ESM graph only until packaged encrypted graph parity lands
examples.skipReason: managed ESM loader or dynamic import graph may be unavailable

examples.title: stable worker_threads migration

safeProfile.behavior: Stable native workers are available with bridge isolation, nested-worker denial, resource budgets, and lifecycle cleanup

examples.packagedBehavior: packaged worker execution is provided by the three-ABI runtime kit with scoped source graphs
examples.skipReason: runtime errors report unsupported Android/ABI conditions rather than a feature gate

examples.title: controlled HTTP/HTTPS client migration

safeProfile.behavior: Controlled HTTP/HTTPS is stable and permissioned; native HTTP/HTTPS is stable with caller-owned limits

examples.packagedBehavior: packaged network requires explicit capability, Android permission, and provider evidence
examples.skipReason: controlled HTTP/HTTPS provider or network permission may be unavailable

examples.title: stable native Node network module migration

safeProfile.behavior: Native http/https/net/tls/dns modules are stable; dgram remains disabled and native calls do not inherit controlled-provider budgets

examples.packagedBehavior: packaged native network requires Android INTERNET permission and remains inside the application sandbox
examples.skipReason: platform or permission failures are runtime errors, not profile or build feature gates

examples.title: scoped advanced fs migration

safeProfile.behavior: Safe profile stays scoped to the project working directory and denies expanded roots

examples.packagedBehavior: packaged advanced fs remains gated by close-on-destroy and expanded-root evidence
examples.skipReason: advanced scoped fs APIs or watcher support may be unavailable

examples.title: controlled WASI profile migration

safeProfile.behavior: Safe profile denies raw wasi and node:wasi while pure WebAssembly remains separate

examples.packagedBehavior: packaged WASI requires scoped preopen, fd/env/args, resource, and worker evidence
examples.skipReason: controlled WASI provider may be unavailable

examples.title: debug inspector profile migration

safeProfile.behavior: Safe profile denies inspector and debug session authority

examples.packagedBehavior: packaged inspector is release-denied until debug UI and redaction evidence land
examples.skipReason: debug profile or inspector provider may be unavailable

examples.title: sanitized pure JavaScript npm dependency migration

safeProfile.behavior: Safe profile allows only checked-in sanitized pure JS dependencies and denies registry/lifecycle/native paths

examples.packagedBehavior: packaged dependency distribution remains gated by integrity and builder evidence
examples.skipReason: package manager facade or dependency corpus metadata may be unavailable
